Title: Azure Store available to direct EA customers and channel partners

Body.Content: Azure Store is available to customers and channel partners subscribed to Azure via a direct Enterprise Agreement (EA). If you're an Azure EA customer in North America or Europe, you can purchase a range of application and data services from 3rd party providers and your subscriptions will be automatically billed against your EA. Pricing for services in Azure Store is set by 3rd party sellers. Store purchases are not eligible for Microsoft’s volume licensing discounts, and Azure monetary commitment balances cannot be utilized for Store purchases. Customers will be billed against their EA each quarter for all of their Store purchases on a separate, consolidated invoice.  Azure Store is not available to customers enrolled in Azerbaijan, Croatia, Norway and Puerto Rico. Manage your purchases in Azure Store on the Manage Accounts and Subscriptions page under the Accounts section in the Enterprise Portal. Visit the Azure Store to learn more.
